description: Today, Oregon's 4th Congressional District candidate, retired Air Force Colonel Monique DeSpain, called out the vote cast by Congresswoman Hoyle, refusing to denounce the horrors of socialism. Last Friday, H. CON. RES. 58 received a strong bipartisan total of 285 yes votes, including 86 Democrats.
